drivers.description: Wet-year sensitivity: farm output and food services ×0.8; housing and recreation unchanged

rubric.explanation: Illustrative 0–100 indicators: Economic 80% productive capacity / 40 + 20% funded upkeep; Social 80% food, occupied-home and recreation services / 18 + 20% undisrupted sites; Environment 80% vegetated share of managed sites + 20% operational storage / 100 m³. Bounded targets prevent unlimited score stacking. This starter rubric omits jobs, energy and pollution; table profiles are not score increments.
